provenance: OC-025: SPARC Toroidal Field Model Coil (TFMC) screening parity from the published record only - Hartwig et al., IEEE TASC (2023) 3332613; Vieira et al., IEEE TASC (2024) 3356571; IAEA FEC 2023 synopsis. Published: 16 pancakes x 16 turns (256 total), 270 km REBCO, 40.5 kA terminal, 20.1 T peak on conductor, 20 K supercritical He, WP min turn radius 0.2 m. Derived: ~250 tapes per turn stack (270 km / 256 turns / ~4.2 m mean turn) modeled as strands_parallel sharing the terminal current. Geometry: the stack-in-plate D-shaped pancake is modeled as a closed D path (straight inner leg + two R0.44 m quarter corners + R0.719 m outer arc); pack centered on the path puts the inner pack edge at the published 0.2 m min turn radius, and the ~4.2 m mean path reproduces the published mean turn length (modeled installed conductor 268.8 km vs published 270 km). tape_width_m is the axial pancake pitch (50 mm plate+joint allowance, inferred not published); radial_pitch_m the spiral channel pitch (30 mm stack+wall allowance, inferred). Requirement framing: b_target_t is a declared bore target at the modeled D-center (the real magnet's published metric is peak-on-conductor 20.1 T, which this case does not claim to reproduce); the case tests whether the real turn/stack choice screens clean and what the BOM recovers. Material screening uses robinson-superpower-ap-v3-modelext - the measured SuperPower AP data (Wimbush/Strickland figshare 4256624, CC-BY; 20-40 K x <=8 T measured) extended by a declared model to 20 T, data_class measured_with_model_extension - as the nearest proxy for VIPER-era tape that covers TFMC conductor fields. Operating point declared at 25 K, strictly interior to the dataset span (the built magnet runs 20 K). limits.along_current_model = transverse_bound is declared (schema v6+): corner-azimuth points whose field leans toward along-current are queried at the transverse-plane angle as a bounded estimate - a declared conservative model, not silent extrapolation.
